typography.$description: Composite type: $value is a fixed object of five sub-values (fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight), each either an explicit primitive value or a {reference}. Aliases resolve against the merged token tree, so this file assumes it's built alongside color.tokens.json, dimension.tokens.json, and font.tokens.json rather than in isolation. lineHeight is a bare number (a multiplier of fontSize), not a dimension — this is the one sub-value still contested in the spec's open issue #102.

heading.$description: fontSize reused a spacing token as a stand-in dimension reference — a type scale token would normally live in its own dimension.fontSize group instead.
